A dependency-only release. No tool was added or removed — the server still
declares 110 — and no server code changed. The bundle is rebuilt with the
dependencies updated by the August and September security advisories, so
what you download carries the patched versions.

## Security patches

All three are transitive dependencies of the MCP SDK; none is imported by
the server itself.

- **hono** 4.13.3 → 4.13.7 — `parseBody()` no longer accepts unbounded
  dot-notation nesting (memory exhaustion), the query parser stops reading
  parameters past the URL fragment, and the `toSSG()` fix for CVE-2026-39408
  is completed.
- **qs** 6.15.2 → 6.16.0 — array-limit bypass through bracket keys with
  commas; denial of service via an attacker-controlled `isBuffer`.
- **fast-uri** 4.1.2 → 4.1.4 — five host-confusion and SSRF advisories in
  IPv6, percent-encoding and scheme-relative normalisation. The override in
  `package.json` moves up to `>=4.1.4`.

## Version updates

- **axios** 1.19.0 → 1.20.0 — hardens runtime option reads against prototype
  pollution and normalises interceptor replacement. Its only deprecations,
  the `PayloadTooLarge` and `UnprocessableEntity` status aliases, do not
  appear in this code base.
- **@types/node** 26.2.0 → 26.4.1 and **tsx** 4.23.12 → 4.23.13 — development
  only, not shipped in the bundle.

`npm audit` on this release reports no vulnerabilities.

## Install

Download `garmin-mcp-ts.mcpb` and open it with Claude Desktop, or drag it onto
Settings → Extensions. Verify the download first:

```
sha256sum -c garmin-mcp-ts.mcpb.sha256
```

**Full changelog**: https://github.com/sedoglia/garmin-mcp-ts/compare/v4.5.9...v4.5.10
